item.title: Rallying Cry – September 24, 2026
item.description: The UN just passed a landmark declaration to protect island nations from rising seas, a new cat species was discovered for the first time in a century, and a heartwarming GoFundMe helped an 81-year-old pay his wife’s medical bills.
